 Singapore Airlines Has A New Range Of In-Flight Amenities That Even Those Flying Economy Can Enjoy 
 Khoo Yong Hao 
 • 
 20 Oct 2026 
 • 
 Travel 
 • 
 5 minutes reading time 
 Singapore Airlines new in-flight amenities 
 When it comes to providing stellar service, no airline does it better than our beloved Singapore Airlines. There’s a multitude of reasons why it’s been crowned the best in the world this year, and pretty soon, you’ll have another one that just might convince you to fly with SQ over other carriers.
 Come November , passengers aboard SQ flights lasting more than 6 hours across all cabin classes can receive new in-flight amenities to make their time in the air that much more enjoyable. Whether you’re a frequent business traveller or a vacationer with your EOY holiday plans lined up, here’s what you can expect on future SQ flights.
 What are Singapore Airlines’ new in-flight amenities? 
 Just last week, Singapore Airlines announced that in November 2026 , they’ll be swapping out their current set of in-flight amenities, which includes products from brands like Lalique and Le Labo, with a refreshed range.
 Moreover, these amenities will be provided to passengers across all cabin classes , from Suites & First Class all the way to Economy. However, do note that they’ll be available only for SQ flights with flight times of at least 6 hours . Without further ado, take a peek at what you can look forward to receiving during your flights with SQ during the upcoming holiday season.
 Suites & First Class 
 For the fortunate few who’ve got the luxury to nab a seat on SQ’s Suites and First Class, you’re in for a treat. You’ll be pampered with goodies from French luxury cosmetic maison SISLEY ; additionally, there are amenity kits for both him and her, a thoughtful touch for their most esteemed passengers.
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 The ladies’ offerings include a curated range of products from SISLEY’s Sisleÿa range. These include the Black Rose Cream Mask , L’Intégral Anti-Age Eye And Lip Contour Cream , Essential Skin Care Lotion , Restorative Hand Cream , and the L’Eau Rêvée d’Eliya fragrance , all bundled up neatly in a white amenity kit embellished with the brand’s logo and gingko leaf pattern.
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 Meanwhile, the gents receive their amenity kits in a sleek black , packed with products from the brand’s Sisleÿum range. Included in the self-care package are the L’Eau Rêvée d’Alma fragrance , Restorative Hand Cream , Nutritive Lip Balm , Anti-Age Mattifying Gel-Cream , Ecological Compound , and All Day All Year Essential Anti-Aging Protection .
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 The premiums don’t end there; Suites and First Class flyers will also get a new 100% cotton sleeper suit that subtly sports the airline’s signature batik motif, along with coral fleece slippers with improved padding, all befitting of royalty.
 These sleeper suits, along with the ones given out on Business Class flights, will be available on selected medium-haul overnight flights of more than 6 hours and on all long-haul trips .
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 When you’ve got to freshen up, the aircraft lavatories here will be equipped with Eau De Campagne Moisturising Body Lotion , Floral Spray Mist , and Eau De Campagne fragrance , all courtesy of SISLEY. Similarly, travellers waiting for their flights at The Private Room and First Class Silver Kris Lounge can look and smell their best with the help of SISLEY toiletries .
 Business Class 
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 The new Business Class amenities ain’t too shabby as well. For starters, you’ll get a BYREDO amenity kit, featuring the luxury Swedish brand’s Blanche Hand Cream , lip balm , and Blanche Eau de Parfum , alongside eye shades and a dental kit .
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 Weary travellers sitting in Business Class, you’ll be pleased to know that for the first time, you’ll be getting a comfy sleeper suit too. Designed in navy blue, the poly-cotton sleepwear also bears the same batik motifs as its Suites and First Class counterparts, while grey poly-cotton slippers complete the look.
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 Over in the Business Class lavatories, you’ll find BYREDO’s Blanche body lotion and Vitamin E chamomile facial toner to complement your skincare routine.
 Premium Economy Class 
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 Those on a slightly tighter budget are not forgotten, as Premium Economy Class ticket holders can also enjoy a sweet SIA-designed zip pouch that’s made out of recycled materials. Inside awaits an exclusive INK & WATER white tea-scented lip balm , eye shades , socks , and a dental kit .
 Economy Class 
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 Last but not least, Economy Class travellers’ amenity kits trade in the zip pouch for a roomier drawstring pouch splashed with the airline’s iconic batik motif. Reach inside, and you’ll find handy travel essentials such as eye shades , socks , and a dental kit .
 Extra goodies for children 
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 A little surprise is also in store for young travellers tagging along for Suites, First Class, and Business Class flights above 5 hours. They can cuddle with the new garden-themed Beary plushie , perfect to keep them company as they soar through the sky.
 Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 On the other hand, SQ’s latest batch of Toy Story amenities will be just the thing to keep children 12 and under preoccupied. These include a bib for infants, a drawstring bag for children aged 3 to 6, and an activity pad for older kids to tackle during the flight.
 Keep an eye out for these new SIA in-flight amenities in November 
 Should you be jetting off for distant lands in the coming month or so, keep your eyes peeled for these new Singapore Airlines in-flight amenities. We all know how much of a toll spending a couple of hours in the air can have on our bodies, especially for older folks, so we definitely appreciate this updated line of freebies.
